Zeus's salted peanut caramel slab.d: Brown sugar, butter and cream cooked to soft ball with roasted salted nuts, set in a pan and spread with milk chocolate and coarse salt.
Zeus's salted peanut caramel slab.note: Parents Association bake sale, Field Day. 50 cents.

Harlem chicken and waffles.d: Thighs soaked in buttermilk, dredged in paprika flour, fried golden, on hot waffles with warm honey and a dash of pepper sauce.

Bacon egg and cheese on a roll.d: Crisp strips and a fried yolk broken flat under melting American, on a butter-toasted kaiser roll. Ketchup on the side.
Bacon egg and cheese on a roll.note: Free breakfast every school day, 7:30 to 8:00.

Crumb cake.d: Buttery yellow batter baked under a thick layer of brown sugar and cinnamon streusel, dusted with powdered sugar.

Water jug lemonade.d: Squeezed lemons, sugar syrup and cold water, mixed by the jug and poured over ice.
Water jug lemonade.note: Field Day lemonade table. 25 cents a cup.
